faq.title: Questions From International Buyers
faq.description: Everything you need to know before placing your export order with ROOTYM.

faq1.question: Which countries does ROOTYM export to?
faq1.answer: ROOTYM serves buyers across the Middle East, Europe, Asia, Africa and other international markets, depending on product availability and import regulations.

faq2.question: Can I request customized packaging?
faq2.answer: Yes. We provide private labeling, customized packaging sizes and export-grade packing based on buyer requirements.

faq3.question: What documents are provided with export shipments?
faq3.answer: Depending on the shipment, ROOTYM provides Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Bill of Lading/AWB and other export documents as required.

faq4.question: How do I request a quotation?
faq4.answer: Simply submit your inquiry with product name, quantity, destination country and preferred Incoterms. Our export team will respond with a detailed quotation.

faq5.question: Do you support bulk orders?
faq5.answer: Yes. ROOTYM specializes in bulk export orders for wholesalers, distributors, supermarkets and food processing companies.

faq6.question: How is product quality ensured?
faq6.answer: Every shipment undergoes quality inspection, export-grade packaging and compliance verification before dispatch.

faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our export services, products and business partnerships.

quotation.question: How do I request a quotation from ROOTYM?
quotation.answer: Simply complete the enquiry form with your product requirements, destination country, estimated quantity, and packaging preferences. Our export team will review your enquiry and respond with a suitable quotation and next steps.

products.question: Which products are available for export?
products.answer: ROOTYM supplies premium Indian agricultural products including Makhana (Fox Nuts), dehydrated onion products, rice, wheat, potato products, and other export-ready commodities. Product availability may vary based on season and sourcing.

bulkOrders.question: Do you handle bulk and container-load orders?
bulkOrders.answer: Yes. We specialize in bulk supply for importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, food manufacturers, and private label businesses. Both palletized and container-load shipments can be discussed based on your requirements.

countries.question: Which countries does ROOTYM export to?
countries.answer: We welcome enquiries from buyers across the UAE, Middle East, Sri Lanka, Europe, Africa, Asia, and other international markets, subject to product availability and destination-country requirements.

documentation.question: Can you provide export documentation and certifications?
documentation.answer: Yes. Depending on the destination country and product, we can provide the required export documentation and applicable certifications to support customs clearance and regulatory compliance.

packaging.question: Can I request customized packaging or private labeling?
packaging.answer: Yes. We support OEM and private label opportunities for eligible products. Packaging formats, branding requirements, and minimum order quantities can be discussed with our export team.
